B.label: TitanTPP B
B.role: fixed-recipe mechanism anchor and bounded-tuning benchmark reference

MLP.label: equal-parameter adjacent-history MLP
MLP.replacement: h + sum_b a_b V_b GELU(W_b concat(h,hprev))/8
MLP.note: Full has 2r activations and shared output U; MLP has r activations. Report actual cost; parameter matching alone is not FLOP matching.

NoStaticLMM.label: local residual without static Hard-LMM
NoStaticLMM.role: memory contribution conditional on the residual being present
NoStaticLMM.removed: static prototype top-k retrieval module only; its forward becomes identity

S2P2.label: S2P2-matched-head-event
S2P2.role: modern state-space encoder comparator under shared heads
S2P2.input: linear projection of past [log1p(dt),log1p(q)]; replace categorical mark embedding; mask-aware causal scan
S2P2.prediction_state: right-limit state immediately after last observed event; never evolve to ground-truth next time

FlexTPP.label: FlexTPP-native-family-event
FlexTPP.role: joint attribute distribution comparator with observed-time adaptation
FlexTPP.input: past event pairs flattened into causal attribute tokens; observed-history masks; no categorical IDs; attribute/event positions only

positive_transforms.quantity: q_cont + 1 = raw_scale * softplus(z_q); observed q>=0 remains unchanged; decode q_hat samples=max(0,q_cont) before raw averaging

FlexTPP.loss: recorded positive-integer time bin NLL + conditional continuous raw-quantity density NLL given recorded target dt; density at q uses q+1 positive transform and its Jacobian; final target pair only
FlexTPP.point_forecast: mean raw quantity from 256 fixed scrambled Sobol ancestral (u_t,u_q) pairs; sample latent dt, apply recorded-time round/clamp/top-code, then sample conditional q; never insert true next dt
FlexTPP.quadrature_rng: SHA256(dataset id, target identity, fit seed, constant flex_quadrature_v1); independent of epoch/config/checkpoint
FlexTPP.diagnostic: selected checkpoint only: compare 256 vs 512 pairs on first min(4096,Nval) canonical targets; relative raw-RMSE difference <=0.001; otherwise numerical-evaluation failure, no automatic decoder change
FlexTPP.training_time_mass: CDF bin integration with fixed observation map, not continuous density substitution
FlexTPP.implementation_gate: verify flow CDF/inverse-CDF, positivity, Jacobians, censoring, masks and reference equality; unavailable API requires faithful tested adapter, never silently substitute another distribution
FlexTPP.quantity_support_note: Continuous density has q_cont > -1; +1 shift supports observed zero quantities without data clipping. Point decoder clips negative generated q_cont to 0 before averaging. Native continuous density is diagnostic, not a discrete count PMF.

TimeMixer.label: TimeMixer-event quantity forecast
TimeMixer.role: quantity-specialist comparator on the same event targets
TimeMixer.input: past [dt/time_scale, q/raw_scale]; event-index sequence; left pad to 256/64 from the same 255/63 observed events; padding-aware normalization, pooling and decomposition
TimeMixer.quantity_head: q_hat=raw_scale*softplus(output); raw_scale from frozen train statistics
TimeMixer.claim_limit: not a regular-calendar multi-horizon demand benchmark; cannot establish full intermittent-demand SOTA

DeepRenewal.label: DeepRenewal-PyTorch-event
DeepRenewal.input: past positive integer (interval,size) pairs; skip padding recurrent updates; same event target population/history
DeepRenewal.loss: sum of shifted-NB interval and size NLL, final target only
DeepRenewal.time_score: shifted-NB mass on recorded weekly duration
DeepRenewal.native_initialization: pinned MXNet estimator/network initialization translated explicitly; shared dimensions initialized reproducibly, not identical to TitanTPP
DeepRenewal.implementation_gate: equation port from MXNet source; verify shifted support, NB moments/log-probability and LSTM gate ordering on synthetic fixtures; no MXNet GPU install
DeepRenewal.support_gate: Before qualification verify every admitted train/validation interval and size is a positive integer. If not, mark fixed DeepRenewal adapter incompatible; do not filter targets or change support without a revised contract.

shared_input_information.available: only completed observed (duration,quantity) events, their order and availability/padding mask; same frozen lookback and target populations
forbidden: test rows as history or statistics
shared_input_information.validation_history_policy: strictly causal online observation protocol: earlier validation observations may enter later histories only if the inherited frozen loader does so; identical target-prefix hashes across all adapters; no test segment access
shared_input_information.training_target_scope: one final target per frozen training window; native all-token training disabled to match target exposure

training.early_stopping: after completed epoch >= 40 and epoch - earliest_best_epoch >= 40
training.parameter_search: no architecture, batch, optimizer or seed search beyond enumerated LR candidates
training.batch_order: separate loader RNG per dataset/seed; same canonical target permutations across models/LRs, epoch batch-prefix digest recorded
training.initialization: core shared tensors copied from matching B initial seed state; added residual outputs zero, input projections generated in forked RNG. Native adapters follow documented native-family initialization; do not assert cross-family weight equality.
training.common_head: unchanged CountAwareTPP log-MSE quantity head + recorded positive-integer heteroscedastic lognormal duration head; quantity coefficient 1, tail coefficient 0; use inherited train statistics
training.loss_comparability: only common-head track supports controlled encoder/structure attribution; native-family heads/losses differ and are separately labeled

checkpoint_and_evaluation.selection: strict earliest finite minimum validation raw-quantity RMSE at epoch end; same checkpoint for every reported metric
checkpoint_and_evaluation.ties: earliest epoch; exact LR candidate tie c0 before c1
checkpoint_and_evaluation.reuse_equal_endpoint: evaluate both endpoint roles even if tensor digest is identical; do not claim independent models
checkpoint_and_evaluation.time_observation: positive_integer_round_clamp_v1; first bin [0,1.5), k>=2 bin [k-.5,k+.5), Instacart k=30 bin [29.5,infinity); use per-dataset units/scales
checkpoint_and_evaluation.native_continuous_quantity_nll: within-model diagnostic only; do not rank against deterministic quantity heads or discrete NB NLL
checkpoint_and_evaluation.time_model_missing: TimeMixer reports N/A; never use zero or exclude it from quantity table
checkpoint_and_evaluation.time_guardrail: report Full-reference delta with seed-wise direction; no Pareto/joint-superiority claim if time worsens. A tolerance was not prevalidated, so do not invent a passing margin after results.
checkpoint_and_evaluation.reporting: 3 seed arithmetic mean and sample SD ddof=1 plus every seed; do not pool heterogeneous dataset RMSE into a raw mean; no 3-seed confidence claim from target count
checkpoint_and_evaluation.strata: Frozen train quantity and observed-history boundaries; train-only quartile cuts for target duration, mean of last up-to-8 observed log1p quantities, and absolute difference of last two observed log1p quantities. With <2 history events mark change unavailable, not zero. Compute/hash cuts before first fit; deduplicate ties and show N=0/low-N bins. No test statistics.
checkpoint_and_evaluation.new_strata_on_reused_anchors: 12 selected-checkpoint full-validation bridge passes under identical frozen source; reconcile aggregate metrics and target identities before adding duration strata; do not count bridges as new conditions

bootstrap.Taxi: circular moving blocks of 168 consecutive validation targets within each oper_part_no, ordered by seq; keep observed entity mix fixed; wrap within same series only
bootstrap.Intermittent_and_Instacart: resample whole oper_part_no entities with replacement; keep all validation targets of each selected entity; require at least two clusters or flag uncertainty unavailable
bootstrap.pairing: use same resampled targets across every compared model and all three seeds; statistic = arithmetic mean of per-seed RMSE differences
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile descriptive sensitivity interval; no p-value, no significance claim, no independent-event resampling; report seed-wise deltas separately
bootstrap.limitation: already-used validation; does not establish causal mechanism or final-test generalization; 168 is fixed event-block length, not asserted elapsed-calendar length

checkpoint_and_evaluation.cpu_metric_reference: FP64 sums for SSE/SAE and sample SD; reconcile partitions to global sums

cost_measurement_protocol.timing_cells: all 28 model/dataset shapes, use phase-A c0 seed42 for six mechanism models and selected phase-B seed42 for external models; no best-speed seed selection
cost_measurement_protocol.inputs: first min(1024,Nval) targets in canonical order; same observed prefixes, batch sizes 1 and 128; reuse admitted validation, no test
cost_measurement_protocol.timing: torch.cuda.synchronize before/after timed prediction; median and p95; reset and capture peak allocated/reserved memory; report transfers/collation excluded and optional end-to-end separately
cost_measurement_protocol.include: all preprocessing on GPU and full 256-pair Flex decoder needed for prediction, not encoder only
cost_measurement_protocol.training: report complete epoch wall times including validation separately from optimizer-only throughput; every final epoch/stop/step/exposure logged
cost_measurement_protocol.flops: record supported operator FLOPs and omissions; do not invent an exact whole-model FLOP count for unsupported flow/scan ops

mechanism_claim_limits.same_parameter_MLP: required; if equivalent/better at lower cost, specific level/change structural-advantage claim unsupported
mechanism_claim_limits.invertible_coordinate_change: level/change uses no additional information beyond the adjacent pair; value must come from constrained nonlinear parameterization, not information creation
mechanism_claim_limits.level_change_single_path: capacity differs; reduced performance alone does not prove semantic necessity independent of capacity
mechanism_claim_limits.memory: Full vs NoStaticLMM identifies conditional necessity/cost only, not interaction synergy

Distinguish tensor state_sha256 from serialized checkpoint file SHA; resolve and verify both before bridge. Current matrix carries historical state digests, not a claim that serialized checkpoint bytes were read this turn.
reuse_rules.on_mismatch: mark bridge/reuse invalid and stop dependent comparisons; no automatic replacement training or extra budget
reuse_rules.instacart: six B/Full conditions newly train on 5080; original 5090 outcomes retained as prior context and never overwritten/pooled into the new same-host average

tuning_rules.scope_of_fairness: equal new two-LR candidate grid per cell under stated architecture; not equal lifetime researcher tuning budget or native published SOTA reproduction; seed42 is tuning data and three-seed validation summary is descriptive

counts.note: These are complete-plan counts, not promised completions under wall/cost caps. Epoch validation and latency microbenchmarks are separately logged, not counted as endpoint replays. Final table conditions overlap, so 54+48 is not a count of unique fits.

heldout_provenance.untouched_test_status: not established; historical generated test artifact paths exist, especially same manifest paths for Taxi/Instacart; exact historical bytes and use in decisions unconfirmed
heldout_provenance.metadata_preview_limitation: one initial split-manifest preview exposed aggregate target-distribution fields; excluded from choices, later reads allowlisted; no test prediction/metric files opened
heldout_provenance.future_test_gate: separate provenance and final-test contract; seek genuinely unused later/external data if necessary; no moving old test rows into validation

failure_policy.loss_nonfinite_or_oom: capture error and stop that cell; do not shrink batch/change architecture; independent prelisted cells can run within fixed caps
failure_policy.contract_data_or_runtime_mismatch: stop entire dispatch before further fits
failure_policy.stall: stack after 300s without completed batch/eval progress; terminate owned process after 1800s
failure_policy.checkpoint_replay_or_decoder_failure: preserve trained model but mark evaluation invalid; no performance pass
failure_policy.SSH_failure: unknown status; inspect owned claim/tmux/PID; never infer failure or relaunch from missing response
